# planetscale_neki_sidecar (Resource)

NekiSidecar Resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String) Branch name from `list_branches`. Example: `main`. Requires replacement if changed.
- `configuration_profile` (String) The name of the shard configuration profile that owns the sidecar. The API also accepts a sidecar ID here, but Terraform stores the profile name returned by the API, so configure the profile name. Requires replacement if changed.
- `database` (String) Database name slug from `list_databases`. Example: `app-db`. Requires replacement if changed.
- `organization` (String) Organization name slug from `list_organizations`. Example: `acme`. Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `parameters` (Map of Map of String) Desired effective parameter values nested by namespace. The SDK hook uses the prior Terraform value for reconciliation and removes this query parameter before sending the API request.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the sidecar
- `state` (String) The current state of the sidecar

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = planetscale_neki_sidecar.my_planetscale_neki_sidecar
  id = jsonencode({
    branch                = "..."
    configuration_profile = "..."
    database              = "..."
    organization          = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import planetscale_neki_sidecar.my_planetscale_neki_sidecar '{"branch": "...", "configuration_profile": "...", "database": "...", "organization": "..."}'
```
